5. sceneFidelity - 2: The stadium background is present but lacks spatial definition, appearing as a dark, indistinct mass.
6. stylizationStrength - 5: The heavy watercolor/blur effect completely transforms the sharp broadcast frame into an artistic, painterly representation.
